description: Say that this reviewer has begun the open review on a task, before deciding it. The call is recorded, so the audit log shows when each reviewer took the review up as well as when they decided. It decides nothing: the review stays open and the acknowledgement counts towards no rule. Only someone who may decide the review may send it, and anyone else is refused with -32011. A task with no open review is refused with -32010, and a second acknowledgement from the same reviewer in the same round with -32602. Returns requested_at, the time the round opened, which names it.

from.description: This server acts as agent:assistant: it fills this in, and refuses a call that names anyone else.

name: chap.review.acknowledge
title: Acknowledge review
